title: marketplace: a package version's release notes are one string, so a zh-CN reader of the listing sees English release notes
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible gap in shipped listings.

**Business reason.** The marketplace detail page is where a customer decides whether to upgrade. HotCRM's description, tagline and listing pages are per-locale (hotcrm#2392), but release notes are a single string, so zh-CN customers read English notes on a Chinese page (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2461, item 2).

**Reach (read in source).** `releaseNotes` is a single string in `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-version.zod.ts:210,250,263`. The console renders that one field (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:1827`), and the CLI sends one `release_notes`. The cloud catalog lives in another repository and was not read.

**Expected:** release notes keyed by locale, with fallback, so an app can publish a zh-CN summary assembled from its changesets.

**Dedupe:** `releaseNotes per locale marketplace version` returned 0 hits.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the owning lane. Not a claim; awaits triage. Filed on the maintainer's word in hotcrm seat 2's session (2026-11-19): 「平台缺口全部立卡」, after an independent fable-tier review of HotCRM's pending decisions surfaced it.
